svg.title: Between the lakes — Niagara Assembly regional sketch
svg.desc: An editorial schematic of the Hamilton, Niagara, Buffalo, Rochester and Syracuse corridor, extending to Erie and the Finger Lakes. 106 places, selected major roads and local connections. Town positions and road alignments are simplified, not a navigation map.
svg.text: A region of places, people and connections.
Schematic · positions and roads simplified · not for navigation
